mapper.select: SELECT FROM task r JOIN stage s ON s.id=r.stage_id AND s.user_id=r.user_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN goal g ON g.id=s.goal_id AND g.user_id=r.user_id AND g.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN task_assignment a ON a.task_id=r.id AND a.user_id=r.user_id AND a.ended_at IS NULL WHERE r.user_id=#{userId} AND r.id=#{id} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT FROM task r JOIN stage s ON s.id=r.stage_id AND s.user_id=r.user_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN goal g ON g.id=s.goal_id AND g.user_id=r.user_id AND g.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN task_assignment a ON a.task_id=r.id AND a.user_id=r.user_id AND a.ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.sort_order,r.id LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}

SELECT count(*) FROM task r JOIN stage s ON s.id=r.stage_id AND s.user_id=r.user_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN goal g ON g.id=s.goal_id AND g.user_id=r.user_id AND g.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN task_assignment a ON a.task_id=r.id AND a.user_id=r.user_id AND a.ended_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (user_id, stage_id, name, description, completion_criteria, priority, weight, estimated_minutes, start_date, due_date, status, sort_order, completed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{stageId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{completionCriteria}, #{priority}, #{weight}, #{estimatedMinutes}, #{startDate}, #{dueDate}, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, #{completedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET stage_id=#{stageId}, name=#{name}, description=#{description}, completion_criteria=#{completionCriteria}, priority=#{priority}, weight=#{weight}, estimated_minutes=#{estimatedMinutes}, start_date=#{startDate}, due_date=#{dueDate}, status=#{status}, sort_order=#{sortOrder}, completed_at=#{completedAt}, version=version+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND version=#{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
